properties.name: BMW Group Plant Leipzig — AEON humanoid robotics pilot
properties.function: Humanoid robotics pilot in automotive production
properties.description: BMW Group Plant Leipzig is hosting the BMW Group's first European pilot project involving a humanoid robot in production. The AEON system is being tested in battery assembly and component manufacturing.
